anchor_text: Hearing, sight, the heart — He opened them with lights
caption: Traces how divine wisdom reaches the seeker through the God-given instruments.

caption: Shows how creation cascades from light through will, command, and speech into the formula Kun fa-yakun totaling seven letters.

caption: Shows the seven principles of creation with air presiding alone over three primal elements, each generating a consort drawn from itself.
